acceptanceCriteria: Opt-in keep-awake (e.g. macOS `caffeinate -i -w <dispatcher pid>` as a dispatcher child), off by default, documented as not preventing lid-close sleep, with a test that it is absent by default.
A doctor finding reports a recent host suspend from host-sleep.json, with a fixture test.
body: The dispatch lane (commit 1c5a6fc6b, ATR-V0-063..065) delivers suspend-gap detection, cap/lease exclusion and dispatch status hostSleep, but not #1040 criterion 6 (keep-awake) nor a doctor finding for suspends.
title: Opt-in dispatcher keep-awake and a doctor finding for recent host suspends (V1-1597 / #1040 residual)
